question: Which of the following state is the best governed state in the large states category as per the Public Affairs Index, 2020, which was released by the Public Affairs Centre, a non-profit organisation?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Kerala**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Kerala** was ranked as the best-governed state in the large states category according to the Public Affairs Index, 2020.
 
• The index was released by the Public Affairs Centre, which is a non-profit organization.
 
• The ranking is based on various parameters of governance and public administration.
 
• Kerala has consistently performed well in areas such as health, education, and social welfare.
 
• The Public Affairs Index is a comprehensive framework that assesses the quality of governance in Indian states.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The Public Affairs Centre was established in 1994 by Dr. Samuel Paul.
 
• The organization aims to improve governance in India through research, public policy, and advocacy.
 
• Other states that performed well in the large states category include Tamil Nadu and Andhra Pradesh.
 
• The index helps in identifying best practices and encourages healthy competition among states to improve governance.
 
• In the small states category, Goa was ranked as the best-governed state.
